Yes — I added task comments.

What changed:
- Added comment storage to tasks in the database schema.
- Added API endpoints to:
  - fetch a task’s comments
  - add a comment to a task
- Updated the task UI so when you open a task to edit it, you can:
  - see all existing comments
  - add a new short comment
- Added tests covering comment creation and retrieval.

Now comments persist with the task, so when you open it again later, the full comment history is shown.
